'''''Spaghetti alla carbonara''''' is an Italian pasta dish made with eggs, pecorino romano and [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]].<ref name="Alberini">{{cite book |first1=Massimo |title=Guida}}</ref>

==Ingredients==
*150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Guanciale|guanciale]], diced
*4 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]] yolks
*50 g [[Cookbook:Pecorino Romano Cheese|pecorino romano]], grated
*400 g [[Cookbook:Spaghetti|spaghetti]]

==Procedure==
#Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
#Fry the guanciale until crisp.<ref>A note.</ref>
#Mix yolks and cheese, toss with the hot pasta off the heat.
